raw_html: [[Acid Arrow#Acid Arrow| Acid Arrow]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Acid Arrow#Acid Arrow| Acid Arrow]]:''' This bow coats your arrows in corrosive acid. A successful hit douses the target in acid causing an additional 6 to 15 damage after two seconds have passed. Each additional hit extends the duration of the acid damage by two seconds.
